summary: ARMOUR Residential REIT filed a Form 8-K on September 24, 2026, announcing guidance for its October 2026 monthly common stock dividend of $0.24 per share, payable to holders of record as of October 15, 2026, with payment on October 29, 2026. The filing was signed by CFO Gordon M. Harper and includes the dividend press release as Exhibit 99.1. As a REIT, ARMOUR must distribute substantially all ordinary taxable income; actual dividends remain at board discretion. This is a routine dividend announcement, not a special situation, with no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle.
